# Known findings checklist

Every builder checks its work against this list before handing back. Each line is a defect that an independent review has already found in this project. Hand-backs state "checked against known-findings.md" and list any item that does not apply, with the reason.

1. **Session ID.** A `sessionId` in the body or the query string is rejected with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` on every Arc route, not only the ones the first test covers. The session comes from the cookie only.
2. **Headers and check order.** Every response, including 404, 413, 429 and 503, carries `Cache-Control: no-store`. Checks run in the order the wire contract states (flag, origin, cookie, size, rate limit, store). In-progress reads carry `Retry-After`.
3. **Assert what you return.** A test for a route checks the status, the body fields and the headers, not the status alone. Removing a field or a header must fail a test.
4. **Tests that can fail.** Write the test, run it, and see it fail for the right reason before the fix. A failure must be an assertion, not a timeout or a hang: give any test that waits on a process or a clock its own short timeout.
5. **Fail closed.** Outside demo mode a missing or unavailable store returns 503. No product path falls back to an in-memory or local store. In-memory stores and fakes exist for unit tests and the offline demo only.
6. **Existing assertions.** Never weaken, delete or skip one to make a test pass. A planned change goes in its own commit entry with the reason in the message.
7. **Labels and copy.** "Model estimate", never "saving" or "observed". "Demo-session approval, simulated", never a named supervisor. "Generated by Gemini" only where Gemini wrote the text, in sentence case. Plain words; "purchase order" in user-facing text, not "PO". No banned words.
8. **No hard-coded values.** Limits, prices, model names, regions, caps and figures come from `config/` or the environment, or from a live route. A value on screen traces to a source.
9. **Bounded work.** Reads, writes, query sizes, stream counts, free-text lengths and cached failures are bounded. Free-text fields have a maximum length. An unauthenticated endpoint is rate limited and does not call a provider on every request.
10. **Comments and neighbours.** A comment explains why, not what. When behaviour changes, update the comments, docs and tickets that described the old behaviour.
11. **No copies.** Reuse the existing helper (the Firestore transaction loop, the Zod issue mapping, the validation helpers) instead of copying it.
12. **Gemini calls.** Every call goes through the budget wrapper inside `runAsGeminiCaller`, so the session and IP limits apply. Untrusted content (orders, photos, documents) never reaches a system instruction.
13. **Cost-bearing paths.** Say what each new Firestore read, BigQuery query or Gemini call costs, and the cap that bounds it.
14. **Claims.** Every number in the hand-back comes from a run you did. Anything you could not run is NOT RUN with the reason, and a cloud or live check is never claimed as passing.
15. **Contract and design.** The wire contract, the design records and the ADRs are the authority. If code and contract disagree, fix everything else and report the disagreement; do not stop the whole packet, and do not choose quietly.
